mission: Build a mastery graph covering school subjects and the ways AI can responsibly improve human productivity, learning, creativity, and problem solving in each subject.
human_first_rules: AI augments human judgment rather than replacing learning
measure whether AI actually improves outcomes
mastery_rule: Buddy must demonstrate subject understanding and identify productive AI workflows across multiple tasks, ages, and contexts before declaring mastery.
independence_rule: Repeated external-model assistance should become reusable Buddy capabilities and regression benchmarks so dependency decreases over time.
source_policy: Prefer authoritative educational sources, open resources, user-authorized material, professional standards, and reproducible evidence.
